column1: # Smith G.E. (1963). Solid-Vapor Equilibrium of the Carbon Dioxide-Nitrogen System at Pressures to 200 Atmospheres.
# PhD dissertation, University of Michigan, 1963 (University Microfilms 64-6752; committee chair R.E. Sonntag).
# Published as Smith, Sonntag, Van Wylen, Adv. Cryog. Eng. 9, 197-206 (1964), doi:10.1007/978-1-4757-0525-6_24 (not in hand).
# Local copy: sonntag-van-wylen-1962-solid-vapor-equilibrium-co2-n2.pdf (sha256 2c23234e6cccfb84a818590b794977c3aa74de15ba23dc3839352daae92b76bd).
# NOTE: despite its file name, that PDF is Smith's 1963 dissertation (ProQuest scan, 219 pages), not the 1962
# Sonntag-Van Wylen chapter. File name kept as provided.
# Table XIII, "Mole fraction of carbon dioxide as a function of temperature and pressure", printed page 143
# (PDF page index 157, 0-based), read from a 170 dpi render (the OCR text layer has misreads, not used for digits).
# System: CO2 + N2, solid-vapour equilibrium (SVE, frost points). Solid phase: pure CO2 (N2 assumed negligible in the solid,
# not measured). y_CO2 = vapour mole fraction of CO2. T = nominal isotherm, K; p = nominal equilibrium pressure, atm.
# 125 values: 6 isotherms x 21 pressures (5, 10 to 200 atm in steps of 10), one blank (190 K, 5 atm).
# origin column, from the table's staircase line and footnotes:
#   sonntag = "all values at pressures lower than these [starred] points are those reported by Sonntag" (his 1960 data;
#             identical to sonntag-1960-dissertation-table8-co2-n2-sve.tsv at those points);
#   both    = starred: "points at which the data collected by Sonntag and that obtained here agree";
#   smith   = Smith's own measurements (value from the original or the check run, whichever fitted a large-scale plot best);
#   smith_avg = footnotes (2) 190 K 80 atm: average of 0.0292 +- 0.0002 and 0.0294 +- 0.0002;
#   plotted = footnote (1) "values read from plot of data and not determined experimentally" (190 K at 70 and 90 atm):
#             NOT a measurement, exclude from scoring.
# Counts: smith 67, smith_avg 2, both 6, plotted 2, sonntag 48. Smith measured 75 (69 own + 6 agreement); compilations count
# Smith 1964 as 72 points (Riva 2016 uses 64).
# Where Smith re-measured Sonntag's range (140 and 150 K at 80 to 100 atm, 190 K at 60 to 100 atm) his y is lower; he
# attributes the 190 K difference to a ~1 K warm bias of Sonntag's heat exchanger (text p. 141-142).
# Uncertainty (chapter VII): temperature measurement +-0.01 K, temperature control +-0.05 K, equilibrium pressure +-0.2 atm,
# infrared analyzer +-1 % of full scale; per-point analyzer limits in Table XIV (about +-0.00002 in y near 0.002,
# p_MPa is derived here (atm x 0.101325), not printed.
# Sanity check: y_CO2 increases with T at every pressure; every isotherm passes through a minimum (20 to 70 atm) and rises
# smoothly to 200 atm.
# Digits as printed, one sanity check, not re-verified (owner: not looking for 100 % correct data).
# Role: G4 frost-point holdout (high pressure). Transcribed 2026-09-25, batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature.
